reason: Harvested by driving every reversible action at 1440x960 (owner-flight, editor open on demo-audience-item-invitations). The six strings are exactly as quoted: stepper +7 -> "Send the invitations moved 7 days later." (rendered as: Send the invitations moved 7 days later.), -1 day -> "Send the invitations moved 1 day earlier.", typed date -> "Send the invitations moved 33 days later.", rename -> "Renamed to Rehearsal dinner.", hide -> "Send the invitations is now hidden from guests.", show -> "Send the invitations is now shown to guests.", delete -> "Send the invitations was removed.", add -> "A moment was added." So the transcription is accurate. The finding still fails on four counts. (1) It misreads the lessons rule. lessons.md line 66 reads: "One grammar per fact. One scan once carried four grammars for one fact (elapsed, deictic, weekday, date). Pick one." That is one FACT wearing four grammars at once. Here six different facts wear six sentences, and two of them are a different KIND of change: move/delete/add are events, hide/show is a state toggle. "is now hidden from guests" states the consequence the owner actually cares about - what guests see right now - and is the correct register for a toggle; "was hidden from guests" would report an event and drop the standing consequence. Different kinds of change legitimately reading differently is not the defect the library names. (2) The fix would make it worse against the governing voice rule. studio/BRAND.md line 98: "Verbs over nouns. Active over passive." The proposal converts the one active line - and it is the product most frequent reversal, the stepper move - into passive ("was moved"), and standardises all six on past passive. Flattening active voice into passive for the sake of tense symmetry trades the brand stated voice for uniformity. (3) The claim that "two of the six refuse to say which moment changed" is half wrong. Add genuinely has no name to give (the fresh record title is empty and the field is focused for typing) - the finding own fix concedes this, and "A moment was added." -> "A new moment was added." adds a word and no information. That leaves rename. But the bar TRAVELS INTO the editor (LANGUAGE.md behaviour 2; moveUndoBar at render-b.js:909), so at rename time the sentence sits inside a panel whose aria-label is "Editing Send the invitations", with the title field two rows below it; and after the editor closes, "Rehearsal dinner" is the exact string now printed on the rail. Naming the NEW title is the more locatable reference; the proposed subject - the pre-edit name - names a string that no longer exists anywhere on screen. The scenario offered (moved one thing and renamed another) also does not arise: paintUndo only ever paints history[length-1], so the bar shows the rename alone. (4) The rewrite breaks four ratified behaviour-gate assertions for at most one word of gain: interaction-check.mjs:454 asserts /Send the invitations moved 7 days earlier./ (dies on "was moved"), :850 asserts /Renamed to/ - case-sensitive, dies on "was renamed to" - :904 asserts /Send the invitations was removed/ (dies on "was deleted"), and :935 asserts /is now hidden from guests/ (dies on "was hidden from guests"). The .num check the brief flags is a non-issue either way: paintUndo builds the sentence from an array and wraps any numeric part in span.num (shell.css:210, tabular-nums), and the proposed strings keep the array shape, so the number register survives. The one atom with merit is that the control says "Delete this moment" while the bar says "was removed" - a real verb mismatch. It is one word, and it cannot carry a finding whose thesis and whose fix are both wrong.
sharpenedFix: If anything is taken from this, take only the single-word alignment and leave the other five alone: "Send the invitations was deleted." so the report uses the verb the control used, updating the interaction-check.mjs:904 assertion in the same change. Do not passivise the move, the rename, or the visibility lines - the move is the one active sentence in the product most-pressed reversal and BRAND.md puts active over passive, and "is now hidden from guests" reports a standing state, not an event.
